# meshoptimizer (gltfpack)

Official project: https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer
Upstream CLI docs: https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer/blob/master/gltf/README.md
License: MIT, see https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer/blob/master/LICENSE.md

The source project implements GPU vertex-cache and vertex-fetch optimization, mesh compression and quantization, animation resampling, and optional simplification. Official native gltfpack binaries are on https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer/releases .

This plugin contains **an original CLI integration**, not the native gltfpack program or its full source tree. The environment could not clone the upstream repository because `github.com` did not resolve. `get_official_meshoptimizer_source.sh` retrieves it when network is available. All upstream rights remain with their respective authors.
